lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅拎着两只空水壶和一壶水走到窗口前，袖口湿了一截。
lines.en: Sophia walks up to the window carrying two empty canteens and a jug of water, her cuffs half soaked.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 配给站那根主水管裂了大口子，刚放了一半就彻底断了水。
lines.en: The ration station's main water pipe split wide open. The water cut out completely halfway through.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 维修工拿破布胡乱缠了两圈，推说要到下午才能修好。
lines.en: The repairman wrapped a couple of rags around it and said it won't be fixed until afternoon.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 家里够用吗？
lines.en: Enough water at home?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺清早接了一大盆备着，我们母女俩今天是够用了。
lines.en: Eleanor filled a big basin early this morning. That's enough for the two of us today.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 只是过道尽头那位腿脚不便的老人，排到一半实在站不住了。
lines.en: But the old man at the end of the hall, the one with bad legs, couldn't stand halfway through the line.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 隔壁带三个孩子那户也没接着水，这会儿正关起屋门发愁呢。
lines.en: The family next door with three kids didn't get any either. They've shut themselves in, worrying.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 刚才隔着两条街都有人趁机哄抬，一壶水竟要抵三天营养果。
lines.en: Two streets over, people are already gouging. One jug of water for three days of Nutrifruit!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这儿按原价卖。
lines.en: I sell at the usual price.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我就知道你是个做实在生意的，不会趁着这时候跟着乱涨。
lines.en: I knew you were honest. You wouldn't jack up prices at a time like this.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 带孩子那家的旧水盆底下漏了，我想替他们买两只结实点的。
lines.en: The family with kids has an old basin that leaks. I want to buy them two sturdier ones.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 顺便再挑几件擦洗用的杂物，这钱你必须照实跟我算。
lines.en: And a few things for scrubbing. You charge me the real price, understand?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 谁也不准白送谁东西，不然我下次可不来你这儿买了。
lines.en: Nobody gives anything away for free, or I won't shop here again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 下午我早点打烊。
lines.en: I'll close early this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 水来了替他们提几趟。
lines.en: When the water comes, I'll haul a few trips for them.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那可太省力气了，到时候我也跟着去配给站排队接应你。
lines.en: That'll save so much effort. I'll wait in line at the ration station to meet you.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 咱们先把眼前的买卖结了，你看我拿几件水盆合适？
lines.en: Let's settle this first. How many basins should I take?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你自己挑，先掂掂这只。
lines.en: Pick for yourself. Try lifting this one.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这只大盆空着拎都觉得坠手，装满水我可端不稳。
lines.en: This big one's heavy even empty. Filled with water, I'd never hold it steady.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 还是把旁边那两只小的拿过来，给我仔细看看成色吧。
lines.en: Bring over those two small ones instead. Let me look them over properly.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 一大一小，刚好分两家。
lines.en: One big, one small. One for each family.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你这算盘打得比我还快，连怎么分都替我想好了。
lines.en: You calculate faster than I do. You've even worked out how to split them.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不过东西总得我亲手挑过了，拿回去用着才真正放心。
lines.en: Still, I have to pick them myself, or I won't feel easy using them.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 带够了吗，别拿超了。
lines.en: Brought enough? Don't overspend.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: （她下意识按住腰间的钱袋）你这孩子怎么还小看人呢？
lines.en: (She instinctively presses a hand to the purse at her waist) Are you looking down on me, young one?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 就算今天真挑超了预算，那也是我自己乐意掏这个钱。
lines.en: Even if I go over budget today, it's my money and my choice.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 盆底厚实不漏水，价钱也算得这么公道。
lines.en: Thick bottoms, no leaks, and such a fair price.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 下午那边一放水你就过来，我在过道口等着你。
lines.en: Once the water's on this afternoon, come over. I'll wait at the end of the hall.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这数目不对吧，你是不是又偷偷给我抹了零头？
lines.en: This number's off. Did you knock some off again behind my back?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 盆沿有道划痕。
lines.en: There's a scratch on the rim.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你就拿这种借口哄我吧，这份人情我先替邻居记下了。
lines.en: Fine, fool me with that excuse. I'll keep this favor on my neighbors' behalf.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 怎么连你也跟着别人乱抬价，趁着停水敲起竹杠来了？
lines.en: Even you're hiking prices like the rest, fleecing people during the outage?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 钱我照数付给你，但下午提水你可得给我多跑两趟。
lines.en: I'll pay what you ask, but you're making extra trips with the water this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 今天这价钱谈不拢就算了，我再去隔街的杂货铺看看。
lines.en: If we can't agree on a price, never mind. I'll try the shop on the next street.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不过刚才说好下午帮忙提水的事，你那边还作数吗？
lines.en: But about hauling water this afternoon, does that still stand?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 作数。
lines.en: It stands.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅正站在窗前收拾袋子，一名喘着粗气的居民突然冲了过来。
lines.en: Sophia is packing her bags by the window when a panting resident rushes up.

lines.speaker: Resident
lines.text: 店里还有没有干净水卖，我在那边排了一天都没接着！
lines.en: Got any clean water for sale? I stood in line all day and got nothing!

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我这壶水是刚接出来的，你要是急用就先拿去救个急吧。
lines.en: This jug is fresh. If you need it that badly, take it for now.

lines.speaker: Resident
lines.text: 那我就不客气了，算我欠你一回！
lines.en: Then I won't be polite. I owe you one!

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: （她被一把推得踉跄跌坐下去）嘶……我的脚踝好像扭到了。
lines.en: (She's shoved hard, stumbling to the ground) Ah... I think I twisted my ankle.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 站住！敢在窗前抢人！
lines.en: Stop! Robbing someone at my window?!

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别追了，扶我一把。家里还炖着汤呢。
lines.en: Let him go. Give me a hand? I left soup on the stove.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 扶着我。我送您回家。
lines.en: Lean on me. I'll walk you home.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅清早站在窗口前，把柜台上放着的货逐样看了一遍。
lines.en: Early in the morning, Sophia stands at the window, looking over each item on the counter.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 配给站那根裂口的水管已经裹上铁皮修好了。
lines.en: The cracked pipe at the ration station has been wrapped in sheet metal and fixed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 脚踝好些了吗？
lines.en: How's the ankle?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 歇了一宿已经消肿了，慢点走不碍事。
lines.en: The swelling went down overnight. I'm fine if I walk slowly.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 今天我想给走廊尽头孩子多那户和老太太买点吃的。
lines.en: Today I want to buy some food for the family with all the kids at the end of the hall, and for the old lady.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺没跟来？
lines.en: Eleanor didn't come?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她昨晚跟着提水把手心都磨红了，沾着枕头就睡沉了。
lines.en: Her palms got rubbed red hauling water last night. She was out the moment she hit the pillow.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我干脆不叫醒她，趁着清早人少自己过来转转。
lines.en: So I let her sleep and came over myself while it's quiet this early.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 昨天下午我在窗边看着，你在配给站来回提了好几趟水。
lines.en: Yesterday afternoon I watched from the window. You made quite a few water runs to the ration station.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我也顺路去隔着两条街的摊位转了一圈。
lines.en: I also stopped by the stalls two streets over.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那边一壶水卖到三倍价，连卖干粮的都跟着坐地起价。
lines.en: Water's going for triple there, and even the dry-food sellers jacked up their prices.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 反倒是你这儿的货价，昨天从头到尾也只微调了一半。
lines.en: Your prices, though, only went up half as much all day yesterday.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别家都涨成那样了，你这儿怎么只加了一半？
lines.en: Everyone else hiked theirs like that. Why only half here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 抬狠了以后没人来。
lines.en: Push too hard and nobody comes back.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 水过两天就够，人记仇。
lines.en: Water's back in a couple days. People hold grudges.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 听着倒是十足的生意人算盘，半点亏都不肯吃。
lines.en: Spoken like a true merchant. Not willing to lose a single credit.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那你昨天帮着提水一直忙到天黑，可没收人家一分钱。
lines.en: Yet you helped haul water until dark yesterday and didn't charge anyone a thing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 顺手的事。
lines.en: It was on the way.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 关了店也没事。
lines.en: Closing the shop was fine.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 以前在我的水培农场里，也有个替我看管库房的老人。
lines.en: Back on my hydroponic farm, there was an old man who kept the storeroom for me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 他嘴上成天只谈账目，谁去领物资都要板着脸念叨半天。
lines.en: All he ever talked about was the books. Anyone collecting supplies got a stern lecture.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 可赶上收成不好的年头，他却默默把一半口粮分给新来的工人。
lines.en: But in bad harvest years, he quietly gave half his rations to the new workers.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 事后我去查库房的册子，上面居然连一个字都没记。
lines.en: Afterward I checked the storeroom ledger. Not a single word of it was recorded.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 来，帮我挑两份吃食，孩子要顶饱的，老人牙口差得拿软和的。
lines.en: Here, help me pick two portions. Something filling for the kids, something soft for the old lady's teeth.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我把布袋放台面上，该多少信用点咱们照实算。
lines.en: I'll set my bag on the counter. Charge me exactly what it comes to.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 两家挨着。
lines.en: They're neighbors.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 住得近又怎么样，下层区专坑熟人的摊子可不少。
lines.en: Living close doesn't mean much. Plenty of Lower Level stalls fleece their regulars.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我这儿不这样。
lines.en: Not here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你这人平时话不多，说出来的话倒是一句顶一句硬气。
lines.en: You don't talk much, but every word you say holds firm.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没什么好讲。
lines.en: Nothing to tell.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: （轻声笑了一下）你不愿意讲也行，反正我心里早有数了。
lines.en: (Laughs softly) Fine, don't tell me. I've already figured it out.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 数目算得真清楚，既顶饱又适合老人嚼。
lines.en: A fair tally. Filling, and easy for an old woman to chew.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 要是老太太问起在哪儿买的，我就直接报你这家当铺。
lines.en: If the old lady asks where I got it, I'll point her to your pawnshop.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这数明显少收了，我就先替走廊那两户人家接着。
lines.en: You clearly undercharged. I'll accept it on behalf of those two families down the hall.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 下次可别再这样让利了，不然埃莉诺又要念叨我占你便宜。
lines.en: Don't cut me deals like this again, or Eleanor will nag me about taking advantage of you.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 昨天停水时你还克制着，今天卖点吃食倒多收起来了。
lines.en: You held back during the water outage yesterday, but now you're overcharging for a bit of food.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 钱我照给，不过你这忽高忽低的脾气我可记在心里了。
lines.en: I'll pay. But I'm making a note of these mood swings of yours.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这价钱不太合适，我还是先去配给站那边问问看吧。
lines.en: That price doesn't sit right. I'll go ask at the ration station first.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不过刚才夸你的那些话，我照样算数。
lines.en: Still, I meant what I said about you earlier.

choices.label_en: Raise it too much and they won't come

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅穿了件宽松的家常衣、松松拢着头发，和埃莉诺一起走到窗前。
lines.en: Sophia, in loose everyday clothes with her hair loosely gathered, comes to the window with Eleanor.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，你快抬头看看我母亲今天这身打扮。
lines.en: Hey, look up. Look at how my mother's dressed today.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 出门前我劝她换件正式点的衣裳，她偏不听。
lines.en: I told her to change into something proper before we left. She wouldn't listen.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 也不知是谁出门前对着墙上那面小斜镜照了三遍。
lines.en: And who was it that checked herself three times in that little tilted wall mirror before we left?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那是屋里的镜子太小，一次根本照不全好不好！
lines.en: That mirror's too small! You can't see everything at once!

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 连着几天喝水吃干粮，嘴里实在寡淡得很。
lines.en: Days of nothing but water and dry rations. Everything tastes bland.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 今天过来买点甜食，犒劳一下昨晚提水的功臣。
lines.en: We came for something sweet, a reward for last night's water-hauling heroes.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 要论功臣，昨晚数我手心磨得最红最辛苦了。
lines.en: If we're talking heroes, my palms got the reddest last night. I worked the hardest.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 手伸出来看看。
lines.en: Let me see your hands.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: （摊开手心又飞快缩回）等我母亲走开再给你看。
lines.en: (Opens her palm, then quickly pulls it back) I'll show you once my mother's gone.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我就站在你旁边呢，再小声也听得清清楚楚。
lines.en: I'm standing right next to you. However quietly you say it, I hear every word.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 咳，你别光盯着我看，快评评理。
lines.en: Ahem, stop just staring at me. Be the judge here.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 你觉得我母亲穿这身家常衣怎么样？
lines.en: What do you think of my mother in these everyday clothes?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 总比以前在上层区穿的那些板正衣裳顺眼吧？
lines.en: Easier on the eyes than those stiff outfits she wore on the Upper Level, right?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 挺合身。
lines.en: Fits well.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 还是下层区这种宽松衣裳穿着松快自在。
lines.en: Loose Lower Level clothes like these are much more comfortable.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哼，那我天天穿身上这套，怎么没见你夸一句？
lines.en: Hmph, I wear this outfit every day, and I've never heard you compliment it once.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你穿哪套都好看。
lines.en: You look good in anything.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 少拿这种话糊弄我，我才不稀罕听呢。
lines.en: Don't try to sweet-talk me. I don't care to hear it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我去挑挑台面上的糖盒，你们接着聊。
lines.en: I'll go pick out a candy box from the counter. You two keep talking.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……刚才那句话，你给我留到晚上再说。
lines.en: ...Save what you just said for tonight.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺小时候最馋甜的，还记得自己偏爱哪一口吗？
lines.en: Eleanor had the biggest sweet tooth as a child. Remember which kind you liked best?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 当然是嚼起来嘎嘣响的硬糖，越脆越有味道。
lines.en: Hard candy that crunches, obviously. The crunchier, the better.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 老板，要不要我顺便也给你装上一份？
lines.en: Shopkeeper, shall I pack some for you too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不要。
lines.en: No.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那我就直接买两份吧，反正埃莉诺回头准会分给你。
lines.en: Then I'll just buy two. Eleanor's bound to share with you later anyway.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 谁说我一定会分给他了，那得看他表现。
lines.en: Who says I'll share with him? Depends on how he behaves.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 行，那就按两份硬糖的量给我们拿货吧。
lines.en: Fine, give us two portions of hard candy.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 算清楚点，今天可是我母亲亲自掏钱。
lines.en: Count it right. My mother's paying out of her own pocket today.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你定。
lines.en: Your call.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 就知道把话推给我，那我自己拍板算好看了。
lines.en: Always passing it to me. Fine, I'll decide myself. Happy?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你们两个这默契，不知道的还以为提前对过词呢。
lines.en: The way you two sync up, anyone would think you'd rehearsed.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 像你。
lines.en: Like you.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 胡说，我跟她穿衣风格哪有一点像的地方……也就眼睛随她。
lines.en: Nonsense, our styles are nothing alike... Only my eyes take after her.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这丫头打小只要听见别人夸她像我，准要顶这一句。
lines.en: Ever since she was little, whenever someone says she's like me, she fires back with that.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 东西拿稳了，埃莉诺你来拎着袋子吧。
lines.en: Got everything? Eleanor, you carry the bag.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 听见没有，你那份硬糖现在先归我管了。
lines.en: Hear that? Your share of hard candy is under my care now.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，数目不对吧，你是不是又故意给我们算便宜了？
lines.en: Hey, that number's off. Did you undercharge us on purpose again?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 既然老板让了价，那就当是犒劳咱们昨晚提水的。
lines.en: Since the shopkeeper gave us a discount, call it a reward for hauling water last night.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 哼，那我可就不客气地收下了。
lines.en: Hmph, then I won't be polite about it.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 不是吧，连买包解馋的甜食你都要多收一截？
lines.en: Seriously? You're overcharging even for a bag of sweets?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 难得找到她小时候爱吃的这一味，贵点也值得。
lines.en: It's rare to find the flavor she loved as a child. Worth a bit extra.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 既然你收这么贵，我最多只给你留两颗。
lines.en: Since you're charging this much, I'll save you two pieces at most.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 店里眼下没有合适的甜食，那咱们今天就先回去吧。
lines.en: No suitable sweets in the shop right now. Let's head back for today.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 反正水管已经修好了，回去喝口干净水也觉得带甜味。
lines.en: The pipes are fixed anyway. Even a sip of clean water will taste sweet.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 白开水能有什么甜味，母亲你又拿我寻开心。
lines.en: How can plain water taste sweet? Mother, you're teasing me again.

choices.description_en: Turn the judgment back to her.
